Lower Hondovalle is your base. Gather by hand, build buildings and let them produce resources on their own: the village works even when the game is closed.
Each building produces a resource every second. Each copy costs 15% more than the previous one. At 10, 25, 50 and 100 copies, upgrades appear that double production.
Elara, Marcus and Vesper remember your choices. Their words change with their faction's reputation, with your name and with what you have become.
Here you see how much the village produces per minute. Feats, Memories, cards and the state of the Valley multiply production.

Dungeons are mirrors of your Burden. Descending costs 1 Supply per floor. What you find goes into the Satchel: it's yours only if you return to the surface. If you fall, you lose three quarters of it. Every 5 floors there's a boss.
Equipment in 7 slots, with rarities from Common to Ancestral. You can upgrade, salvage, sell and forge. Each level gives a Talent Point for the Paths (Cult, Capital, Farmers, Revolt).
Daily chest and missions, the dreams of the Living Save, feats (+2% production each), the bestiary and the chronicle of everything the valley remembers.
Tap the water, wait for the bait to sink and tap again at the right moment. Each species you fish up is a memory of the valley: +1% production forever.
The map is a constellation. Choices light stars; with Insight you can read others. Here you find Promises, Fate Shards, Contracts and the state of the shared valley.
The factions ask for resources. Delivering them raises their reputation, but the rival faction loses a little.
Eight factions, no single karma. Each faction has a rival. The states (Ignored, Tolerated, Trusted, Adored, Feared, Banished, Branded) change prices, dialogue, events and endings.
Every 10 minutes the storyteller tells your story: production ×2 for 90 seconds.

Kael and Lyra follow you into the dungeons. Their trust rises when you protect and collapses when you use them as shields: below 25 they hesitate, at 0 they leave. You can send them on expeditions that last real hours, even with the game closed.
Dissonance is not just a penalty: you can spend it on powerful but destabilizing actions (Dark Pact, Tactical Betrayal, Supply Pyre). The world notices.
Destiny is traded here: items with a story, Fate Shards and resources. Prices depend on the Market Shadows. Every trade stays in the Ledger of Souls.
You can let your hero fight alone: it uses abilities coherent with your Burden, the Echo when it's ready and a potion below the threshold chosen in Options. It never uses Dissonance actions.
Every day all the bearers strike the Ash Colossus. You have 3 attempts of 10 rounds: the more damage you deal, the better the rewards.
Relics buy permanent upgrades in the Sanctuary. When you close a Cycle you get an ending, permanent Memories, and your bearer becomes an echo that the next ones will meet.
Your first choice has become a mechanical scar. Every Burden has a weight (light = act first, heavy = hit harder), an advantage, a cost, an Echo and a Shadow.

Every action has a nature (protection, sacrifice, cruelty, betrayal, silence, faith, blood). In battle a GREEN border marks an action coherent with your Burden: it charges Resonance; with a full bar you unlock the Echo. A RED border marks a contrary action: it builds Dissonance. No choice is wrong: it is simply yours.
Ruthless actions raise Corruption, protective ones lower it. High Corruption: stronger enemies, richer loot and, above 60%, an interface that starts to lie (purify it at the Altar).
Some choices create a Promise with a deadline in expeditions. Kept: Resonance and a Shard. Broken: Dissonance and a Promise Hunter who will look for you in the dungeons.

After each floor you choose: go deeper (richer, riskier) or go back up to secure the satchel. Without supplies you can pledge future max health: if you return you get half back, if you fall it stays until Elara lifts it.

Choose an ability and then the target. The basic attack gives Focus (◆); strong abilities consume it. Melee attacks hit only the front row. Above each enemy you see their next move (⚠). Potions don't use up your turn.
The valley has a state (Bloom, Quiet, Tension, Corruption, Ash, Eclipse, Rebirth) that changes production, enemies and loot. Buildings, promises, corruption and shards shift it.
